rejected_rule.statement: When a Christian child has applied to be admitted to Kingswood College, Kandy under any category, if the documents show that he is a Christian and if the number of Christian children already admitted are not above the allowed percentage of 20% intake under the religion category, then that child has a right to be admitted under Clause 3.2 of the Circular.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: Anyhow, when a Christian child has applied to be admitted to Kingswood College, Kandy under any category, if the documents show that he is a Christian and if the number of Christian children already admitted are not above the allowed percentage of 20% intake under the religion category, then that child has a right to be admitted under Clause 3.2 of the Circular.
rejected_rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Act No. 5 of 1960 and Act No. 9 of 1961
